Upstream merged #60 (ADC/SBC HL carry fix) and #61 (flag profile R1-R7),
and added its own commits (#62), including a WZ update for IX/IY-prefixed CB
instructions. #61 was merged at its first commit, so the R8-R11 and R12/R13
commits are offered again as #64; the undefined-opcode fix is #63. vaeg
applies, on the upstream base above and in this order with
`git am --committer-date-is-author-date` and committer
"Nakata Maho <maho.nakata@gmail.com>": the two #64 commits, the #63 commit,
and the M35 IRQ extension rebased onto this base (its test/Makefile conflict
resolved). The result reproduces current_resulting_commit and
current_resulting_tree; z80.hpp, LICENSE.txt and
test/test-interrupt-extension.cpp were copied from that tree.

The vaeg-required downstream extension adds an inspectable and restorable
level-sensitive IRQ line, an acknowledge callback invoked at actual maskable
interrupt acceptance, and raw first-opcode execution for IM0. The vendored
third-party files were reproduced from the approved base and patch; they were
not manually edited.

M101 applies four further downstream patches on top of the M35 commit, in
order, with `git am --committer-date-is-author-date` and committer
"Nakata Maho <maho.nakata@gmail.com>": the ADC/SBC HL,rr carry fix, its
test, the per-instance FlagProfile (Zilog default, Upd9002 for the NEC
uPD9002 Z80 emulation mode), and the Upd9002 DAA/CPL/SCF/CCF rules. M102
applies one more patch on that result, from upstream pull request #63 (with
the test/Makefile conflict resolved): with Z80_NO_EXCEPTION, opcodes without
a handler execute as on a Zilog Z80 instead of calling a null handler; then
the Upd9002 DD/FD CB register-form rules R12/R13 from upstream pull request
#61. The result reproduces m102_resulting_commit and m102_resulting_tree. They are the commits of upstream pull requests
#60 and #61, with the test/Makefile conflict against M35 resolved. The result reproduces m101_resulting_commit and
m101_resulting_tree exactly. z80.hpp was copied from that tree; LICENSE.txt
and test/test-interrupt-extension.cpp are unchanged.
